# nehalist.io

> > A full-stack web development blog by Kevin from Austria, featuring in-depth tutorials on Next.js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.

nehalist.io provides practical guides and tutorials for modern web development, with a focus on TypeScript-based frameworks, authentication patterns, form handling, and full-stack JavaScript development. The site also showcases projects like ilox, a stock alert service that grew to 30,000+ members.

## Key Topics

- Next.js
- Angular
- TypeScript
- React
- NextAuth
- react-hook-form
- Zod
- T3 Stack
- tRPC
- Authentication
- Web Development
- Full-stack Development
- Node.js
- Ghost CMS
- Server Actions

## Core Pages

- [nehalist.io](https://nehalist.io): Homepage: Web dev blog with Next.js, React, TypeScript tutorials and guides
- [About](https://nehalist.io/about): About Kevin: Full-stack developer from Austria, tech stack & blog history
- [ilox](https://nehalist.io/ilox): ilox: Stock alert service for RTX 3000 GPUs, CPUs & consoles (30K+ members)
- [Contact](https://nehalist.io/contact): Contact form, FAQ about newsletter, tech stack (Ghost 5, Tailwind, Mailgun)

## Next.js & React Tutorials

- [How to add Authentication for Next.js with NextAuth, Part 1: Setup & Logging in](https://nehalist.io/authentication-for-nextjs-with-nextauth-part-1): Multi-part tutorial: NextAuth setup and login methods for Next.js apps
- [How to use react-hook-form with Next.js Server Actions and Zod Input validation](https://nehalist.io/react-hook-form-with-nextjs-server-actions): Tutorial: react-hook-form with Next.js Server Actions and Zod validation

## Angular Guides

- [Multiple HTTP Requests in Angular](https://nehalist.io/multiple-http-requests-in-angular): Guide: Sequential and parallel HTTP requests in Angular applications
- [Polling in Angular](https://nehalist.io/polling-in-angular): How to implement polling for periodic data updates in Angular with RxJS
- [Realtime feed with Sails, Angular and SocketIO](https://nehalist.io/realtime-feed-with-sails-angular-and-socketio): Tutorial: Implementing realtime feed with SailsJS, Angular & Socket.IO
